|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E2 of [[Rebel Agent]] and the current text; the card was retitled with it. The images are the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1281-28-front-master.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-L-kylekatarn-pre.gif]]), which print it. The earlier texts are [[Rebel Agent]] (original) and [[Rebel Agent (Errata)]] (PC-E1), both titled Rebel Agent.
* '''Original''' ([[Rebel Agent]]): printed as “•Rebel Agent” on the Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet (official text as of 11 May 2012), p. 5<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf#page=5 Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 11 May 2012"; the surviving copy was re-made 18 July 2012), page 5, slip 28 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095418/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf#page=5 Internet Archive]</ref>: “May use any stolen weapon. Opponent may not ‘react’ to or from same site. Your total battle destiny here is +1 for each [Scoundrel] Effect on table. Once per game, may make a regular move during your control phase. Immune to attrition < 4 (< 5 if armed).”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Rebel Agent (Errata)]]): the PC website card list, still titled Rebel Agent, rewrote the text (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text)<ref name="cl-mid-kyle">Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064747/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212003733/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-12-12], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142925/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2013-01-11]; Virtual Master list (VMasterType), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064754/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VMasterType.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211203905/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 2012-12-11], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111135545/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive)</ref>: “May use any stolen weapon. Opponent may not react to or from same site. Your total battle destiny +1 here, for each [Scoundrel] Effect on table. Once per game, may make a regular move during your control phase. Immune to attrition < 4 (< 5 if armed).” The card list writes the icon as “(Scoundrel)”; the icon here is the printed one. The same text in every capture to 11 January 2013 (VBlock8Type and VMasterType). No published card image shows this text; the image of that page is a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VB8-01-Rebel_Agent-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]).
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): the title changed to “•Kyle Katarn”. The PC website card list shows the new title by 13 March 2013 (the last capture with the old title is of 11 January 2013)<ref name="cl-new-kyle">Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20130313222931/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2013-03-13], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130429063548/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2013-04-29]; VMasterType, as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20130314003713/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 2013-03-14], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130429102413/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 2013-04-29] (Internet Archive; these captures carry no game text)</ref>, and the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Light Side, PDF page 10)<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=10, page 10. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=10 Internet Archive]</ref> prints the card as •Kyle Katarn with the sheet's game text. The Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1281-28-front-master.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-L-kylekatarn-pre.gif]], undated) print it.
